components.name: Canal-house frontage
components.function: Need canal-house frontage/corner/roof host families, quay-water transition, terrace stair and bridge landing; existing ivory lattice/teal roof/water motifs reused. Citrus/palm/bank flora need their own habitat audit. Small fish/waterbirds proposed; no complete city or interiors claimed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated canal-house frontage matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
